skill.name: docx
skill.description: Create, inspect, edit, and validate DOCX files using docx-js examples, OOXML workflows, and Python helpers for comments and tracked changes.
skill.summary: Work with DOCX files through document generation, OOXML editing, comments, tracked changes, and validation workflows.
skill.author: Azeem-2

security_audit.summary: The skill does not show malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection. Real security concerns remain in unsafe archive extraction of Office packages and sudo dependency installation guidance, while most other alerts are OOXML namespaces, XML templates, Markdown examples, or fixed validation tooling.

remediation.suggestion: Replace extractall with a safe extraction helper that rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, symlinks, and members resolving outside the output directory.
Remove sudo install commands from the skill workflow and require users to install dependencies through documented, explicit setup steps.
Keep subprocess calls shell-free, require user confirmation before running converters, and document that untrusted documents should be processed in a sandbox.

content.user_title: Edit Word Documents with OOXML Workflows
content.value_statement: Word documents are difficult to inspect, edit, and validate safely. This skill provides structured DOCX workflows for creation, comments, tracked changes, and XML-level review.
actual_capabilities: Create new .docx files with docx-js guidance and examples.
Unpack Office documents into XML for inspection and targeted edits.
Edit Word document XML with a Python Document helper library.
Add comments, replies, tracked changes, relationships, and content types.
Validate DOCX and PPTX structure against schemas and redlining rules.
Convert DOCX files to PDF and page images using external tools.
limitations: Some workflows require local tools such as pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, npm, or Python packages.
Manual XML edits can corrupt documents when validation is skipped or incomplete.
Archive extraction needs safer path validation before use with untrusted Office files.
The skill focuses on Office Open XML files, not legacy .doc documents.

use_cases.title: Review contract revisions
use_cases.description: Plan precise tracked changes, apply them in batches, and validate the reviewed DOCX before delivery.

use_cases.title: Update business documents
use_cases.description: Modify text, add comments, and preserve document structure in reports, proposals, and templates.

use_cases.title: Debug Office XML issues
use_cases.description: Inspect unpacked OOXML files, fix relationships or content types, and repack the document.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Document Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this DOCX file and summarize its headings, key sections, and any tracked changes that are visible.

prompt_templates.title: Create a DOCX Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX draft for this outline. Use clear headings, readable spacing, and a professional default font.

prompt_templates.title: Add Review Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Add reviewer comments to the specified paragraphs. Preserve the existing text and validate the document after saving.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Tracked Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan all required revisions, group them into small batches, apply tracked changes, and verify the final DOCX against the original.

output_examples.input: A contract DOCX needs date changes, party name updates, and review comments.
output_examples.output: A revised DOCX with tracked changes, comments attached to the relevant clauses, and a validation summary.

output_examples.input: A corrupted DOCX fails to open after an image was added.
output_examples.output: A diagnosis of missing relationships or content types, followed by a repaired document package.

output_examples.input: A report outline needs to become a formatted Word document.
output_examples.output: A generated DOCX with headings, paragraphs, page setup, tables, and optional images.

best_practices: Work on document copies and keep the original file available for comparison.
Validate after each batch of XML or tracked-change edits.
Use precise text replacements so unchanged content remains outside tracked changes.
anti_patterns: Do not skip validation after manual OOXML edits.
Do not apply broad replacements that mark unchanged paragraphs as revised.
Do not extract untrusted Office archives without validating every archive member path.

faq.question: Can this skill create new Word documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes docx-js guidance for creating .docx files with text, tables, images, headers, and footers.

faq.question: Can it edit existing DOCX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It unpacks the document, edits OOXML with Python helpers, and repacks the result.

faq.question: Does it support tracked changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a redlining workflow for precise insertions, deletions, and validation against the original document.

faq.question: Does it require external software?
faq.answer: Some workflows need tools such as pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, npm packages, and Python dependencies.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted DOCX files?
faq.answer: Use caution. The current archive extraction helpers should validate archive member paths before processing untrusted files.

faq.question: Can it work with legacy .doc files?
faq.answer: No. The workflows are designed for Office Open XML formats such as .docx and related package structures.
